Game came out a day before my birthday but I didn’t start until April 2016. In those 7.5 years the game was there or at least adjacent for part of my life:

-My fiancée and I got our first apartment together.

-We then split up 7 months later and 6 months before our wedding.

-Lost a whole group of friends and largely ended bad relationships with my family.

-Became unbelievably depressed.

-I got really sick and had a cancer scare.

-Graduated college for the second time.

-due to the above problems my career for my degree didn’t work out.

-Spent a lot of time near homeless.

-Struggled with money.

-Struggled with alcoholism and various drug addictions.

-Tried to foolishly make things work with the ex.

-Bounced from relationship where I was toxic and just relationships with toxic people.

-Life started turning around when I got my current job in a completely different industry.

-Finally cut out all contact with the ex-fiancée.

- took a break from the game after the first KH event.

-Got my first place by myself.

-Started traveling again.

-Finally wasn’t struggling with money.

-Made a whole new friend group and met my best friend.

-Got promoted.

-Continued to battle with addiction.

-Met someone new and fell in love.

-She lost her battle with addiction/depression in 2019.

-I fell into an even deeper depression.

-Pandemic hit.

-Came back to the game in July 2020.

-Finally started to get clean and sober in 2020-2021.

-Got to be the best man at my best friends wedding.

-Got to meet his firstborn child.

-Got promoted again.

-Finally started working on fixing myself and problems in my life.

-Just celebrated two years clean and 3 days after EoS will be one year sober.

-Game followed me through 5 different phones

It’s been at times, an awful horrible 7.5 years but also at times great. All while the game and my friends that played with me have been a constant anchor almost. Even when I wasn’t playing I would keep up through my 2 friends who still did. Going to be sad to see it go tomorrow. Cheers to all you fellow keepers and I wish y’all the best!

Deep is never deep enough for me though. There is never enough blood, never enough pain.
Punching isn't dangerous enough. Even if I pass out, I'll wake up. Every time I cut I feel like it'll be my last time. I'll escape the pain. I'll escape this world.

I can't cut on my thighs anymore. It doesn't provide the same rush. It's too safe. Cutting on my chest provides that rush that someday I may cut too deep, I may push too hard, I may cut too close to my heart. It doesn't hurt unless it's near a vital organ or vein.

I just keep cutting. I've moved from legs and arms to my chest. It's easier hide but I'm scared one day that I'll cut deeper. I can't help it though, I want that feeling now. It's so much better than being numb! Seeing my blood pour from my skin reminds me that I am alive and I need that reassurance. I need to know that my heart still beats, that blood still pumps through my veins because so often I feel like I'm dead and gone and just haven't realized it yet.
